de: Protokoll eines Dramas – so starb der Star-Alpinist Nirmal Purja am Broad Peak. Eine Lawine hat in Pakistan eine Expedition auf den Achttausender mehrere hundert Meter in die Tiefe gerissen. Nach über 48 Stunden stand fest: Alle zehn Teilnehmer sind tot, auch der Rekordkletterer Nirmal Purja.
en: Protocol of a drama - this is how the star alpinist Nirmal Purja died on Broad Peak. An avalanche swept an expedition to the top of the 8,000-meter peak several hundred meters deep in Pakistan. After more than 48 hours it was clear: all ten participants were dead, including record climber Nirmal Purja.
la: Protocollum dramatis - hoc modo stella alpinist Nirmal Purja in lata Pecco mortua est. Avalanche expeditionem ad cacumen 8000 metri cacuminis aliquot centena metra alta in Pakistania rapuit. Post plus quam 48 horas constabat: omnes decem participes mortui sunt, inter recordum exhibuit Nirmal Purja.
